messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick check — our dogfooding run of the OTLP proxy for the A100 partner demo failed on the Istio side. Anyone free to help debug?

sam (obs-eng): On it. Any logs? service shows 503 from proxy -> collector.

liam (solutions): Saw similar locally. Can you paste the proxy config? Might be TLS mismatch with the collector cert.

olivia (hw-liaison): Partner confirmed they shipped the test image with cert v2. But our demo infra still uses cert v1. 

maya (partnerships): Ugh. I updated the marketplace README to call out cert rotation but didn't sync the demo env. My bad. 

sam (obs-eng): If it's cert mismatch, quick workaround: set PROXY_TLS_MODE=plain for the dogfood cluster so it falls back. Not ideal for prod.

liam (solutions): Agree. Also we should bump the demo collector to accept both v1/v2 for a week. I'll open a small PR.

nora (product-marketing): Timeline? We have the press blurb scheduled Tue. If the demo is flaky, we can't ship.

olivia (hw-liaison): Partner wants the joint announcement but can delay 48 hours. They prefer stable demo > rushing.

sam (obs-eng): I'll try PROXY_TLS_MODE=plain now on the staging demo cluster and restart the proxy.

deploy-bot: Started deploy job #7623 -> staging-demo (maya)

deploy-bot: Job #7623 succeeded in 41s

sam (obs-eng): Proxy restarted — traffic flows. Collector shows traces from partner app. :tada:

liam (solutions): PR for collector dual-cert mode: https://github.com/redwood-inference/obs-config/pull/182 — adding fallback, tests included.

maya (partnerships): Amazing. I'll update the runbook and call out required cert versions + the PROXY_TLS_MODE env var.

nora (product-marketing): I'll push announcement to Wed morning and mention "demo validated with partner hardware". Thanks team.

olivia (hw-liaison): I'll notify partner we validated and confirm new cert rollout plan.

maya (partnerships): Action items: 1) liam to merge PR and prod patch, 2) sam to add quick revert steps in runbook, 3) olivia to coordinate partner cert rollout. I'll record in the partnership tracker. 

liam (solutions): Will merge after CI passes. ETA 2 hours.

sam (obs-eng): I'll add the runbook snippet in the repo: 

```
# quick fallback
kubectl set env deployment/otel-proxy PROXY_TLS_MODE=plain -n staging-demo
kubectl rollout restart deployment/otel-proxy -n staging-demo
```

maya (partnerships): Great. Thanks everyone. Close the loop here once PR is merged and partner confirms cert plan.

liam (solutions): PR merged. tagging release lead.

olivia (hw-liaison): Partner confirmed scheduled cert rollout for tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

maya (partnerships): Closing thread — demo green. :white_check_mark:
